title: BloFin documents active Flexible and Fixed Earn products
description: BloFin published first-party guidance describing use of its Earn service with flexible and fixed subscription options.
notes: This establishes reviewed operation by August 2025 but is not treated as the original BloFin Earn launch date.

title: BloFin publishes current Earn Service Agreement
description: BloFin published the reviewed Earn Service Agreement governing Flexible, Fixed and Auto-Earn subscriptions, asset-use authorization, redemption and principal-risk terms.
notes: The agreement is used for current risk and custody interpretation; it does not establish the service's original launch date.

title: LBank publishes Earn Service Agreement
description: LBank published the reviewed agreement covering Spot Earn, Locked, Futures Earn and related services, including principal-loss and asset-use terms.
notes: This establishes governing Earn terms by November 2025 but is not treated as an original launch event.

title: LBank documents Spot Earn participation and yield mechanics
description: LBank published first-party Spot Earn participation guidance describing flexible access, first-month subsidies and later arbitrage-linked yield mechanics.
notes: This records a documented product/mechanics milestone, not the original LBank Earn launch date.
